project.description: Swan 打包:检出(app+core 双仓)→ flutter build → sha256 → 跨机 HTTP 登记 167 平台 /api/apks。由平台 POST /api/builds 触发(参数已经平台侧白名单校验,坑 15);也可手工 Build with Parameters。构建环境由脚本自行注入(JAVA_HOME/ANDROID_HOME/FLUTTER_HOME 从 176 .env.local 读取,坑 11),176 本机需满足:/opt/uiautotest/.env.local 含 GITLAB_BOT 凭据与 DASHBOARD_URL、/opt/uiautotest/.venv/bin/python 存在、git 在 PATH。

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SERVER_TYPE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 服务器类型(formal=正式服→release / test=测试服→profile)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: COMMIT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 指定 commit(1-40 位十六进制;留空=分支最新)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: NOTES
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 登记备注(URL 编码串,平台 quote 传入,脚本侧 unquote 解码;手工触发也须传 URL 编码值)

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/bin/bash -xe set -o pipefail cd /opt/uiautotest EXTRA="" if [ -n "$COMMIT" ]; then EXTRA="$EXTRA --commit $COMMIT"; fi if [ -n "$NOTES" ]; then EXTRA="$EXTRA --notes $NOTES"; fi OUTF=/tmp/build_swan_out.$$ /opt/uiautotest/.venv/bin/python scripts/build_swan_apk.py --branch "$BRANCH" --server-type "$SERVER_TYPE" $EXTRA 2>&1 | tee "$OUTF" APK_ID=$(grep -oE 'apk_id=[^ ]+' "$OUTF" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2 || true) rm -f "$OUTF" if [ -n "$APK_ID" ]; then /opt/uiautotest/.venv/bin/python scripts/trigger_smoke.py --suite SMKE --branch "$BRANCH" --apk-id "$APK_ID" || echo "[WARN] smoke trigger failed (打包结果不受影响)" else echo "[WARN] 未解析到 apk_id,跳过冒烟触发" fi
